transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
I feel like I’m always up and moving. Even on a quiet day, I’ll jump from the garden club list to my knitting bag to travel papers without really finishing any one thing.
Has this tendency to jump between tasks and stay constantly on the move been present since your childhood?
Yes, I think so. Even in grade school, my teachers told my mother I was bright but scattered. I’d lose papers, talk out of turn, and wiggle around in my seat before I’d finished my work.
As an adult, do you often find yourself interrupting others or struggling to wait your turn in conversations?
Yes. Waiting in line at the pharmacy makes me quite fidgety—I’ll sigh and feel impatient. And in meetings, I sometimes jump in before it’s really my turn to speak.
